十二、熔岩下的假斗中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟四个人知道历史。
那段历史是这样记录的——诺诺曹临死丧心病狂地引爆了附近的巨型火山，熔岩喷发倾泻，眼看信任城就要毁灭，翔天等人挺身而出，金光狮拼着全身的力量护着信任城，并且交代了寻找拥有冰雪力量战士的任务给奈奈。
翔天和亚树奋力与诺诺曹周旋，不让诺诺曹伤害到任何一个无辜的市民。
那是没有逆转时空之前的原始历史。现在不同了。中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟与中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界引导者猫人族小女孩美雅在一起。
诺诺曹临死丧心病狂地引爆了附近的巨型火山。熔岩喷发倾泻，赤红色的岩浆柱从火山口冲天而起，在天空中炸开成无数道火流，朝信任城的方向倾泻而下。
眼看信任城就要毁灭，金光狮拼着全身的力量护着信任城——圣兽战士化为一道金色的屏障，将岩浆挡在城墙之外，金光的边缘被高温灼烧得不断闪烁。
金光狮交代了寻找拥有冰雪力量战士的任务给中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天和中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树奋力与诺诺曹周旋，不让诺诺曹伤害到任何一个无辜的市民。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天召唤烈风，赤红色装甲在熔岩的映照下燃烧如一团火焰。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树召唤震地龙，双肩钻头旋转，正面挡住诺诺曹机甲的进攻路线。
中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧抬起右腕，星卡插在召唤器中。
猛风以汽车样子从光柱中浮现，随后变形为机器人形态。天光剑在猛风手中。
白光狼同时降临，狼头面甲在熔岩的红光中泛着冷冽的金属光泽，星月弯刀与狼盾在手中。
中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖抬起右腕，星卡插在召唤器中。
地震龙以钻机形态从光柱中降临，钻入地下，破土而出，变形为机器人形态。
中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯抬起右腕，星卡插在召唤器中。
光影飞虎以高铁形态降临，变形为机器人形态，弓箭在手中。这是假斗。

中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧在同步空间中操控猛风与白光狼，中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖在同步空间中操控地震龙，中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯在同步空间中操控光影飞虎。
三尊白元金刚加白光狼与诺诺曹机甲缠斗，剑光、钻头、箭矢交织，将诺诺曹拖在战场上。
战斗是真实的，但白元勇者们没有使出全力。他们可以击败诺诺曹，但此刻不击败。
假斗的目的是拖住诺诺曹，为中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈争取时间——她必须找到暴冰熊，获得冰雪力量，才能化解这场熔岩危机。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈和中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟已经离开了战场，朝暴冰熊所在的雪山方向赶去。

12. Fake fight under lava Huang Xuejing, a little girl from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, Yang Xinying, a little girl from the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World, Tang Qiongkai, a little boy from the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World, and Hu Wei, a little boy from the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World, a giant panda beast, know the history.
That period of history is recorded like this - before his death, Nonochio frantically detonated a nearby giant volcano, and the lava erupted and poured out. Seeing that the city of trust was about to be destroyed, Xiangtian and others stepped forward, and the Golden Light Lion used all his strength to protect the city of trust, and assigned Nana the task of finding warriors with the power of ice and snow.
Xiangtian and Yashu struggled to deal with Nonochio to prevent Nonochio from harming any innocent citizens.
That was the original history before time and space were reversed. It's different now. Huang Xuejing, a little girl from the Chinese Low-level Technology White Yuan Brave World, Yang Xinying, a little girl from the Chinese Low-level Technology White Yuan World of Power, Tang Qiongkai, a little boy from the Chinese Low-level Technology White Yuan Brave World, a giant panda beast boy from the Chinese Low-level Technology White Yuan World, and Hu Wei, a little boy from the Chinese Low-level Technology Thunderbolt Warrior The little boy Xiangtian from the world of vitality brave warriors, the little boy Yashu from the world of vitality brave warriors from the low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors of China, the little girl Tian Nana from the world of wisdom and bravery from the low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors from China, and the little girl Meiya from the cat-human race who is the leader of the world of vitality braves from the low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors from China are together.
Before his death, Nonochio frantically detonated a nearby giant volcano. Lava erupted and poured down, and red magma pillars rose from the crater into the sky, exploding into countless streams of fire in the sky, and poured down in the direction of Trust City.
Seeing that the City of Trust was about to be destroyed, the Golden Light Lion used all its strength to protect the City of Trust - the holy beast warrior turned into a golden barrier, blocking the magma from the city wall, and the edge of the golden light was burned by the high temperature and kept flickering.
The Golden Lion handed over the task of finding warriors with the power of ice and snow to Tian Nana, a little girl from China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors of the World of Vitality and Brave Wisdom.
China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World's brave boy Xiangtian and China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World's Power Brave boy Yashu struggled to deal with Nonochio to prevent Nonochio from harming any innocent citizens.
China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World The brave boy flew into the sky to summon strong winds, and the red armor burned like a ball of flame under the reflection of the lava.
The little boy Yashu of China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World's Power summoned the Earthshaking Dragon, spinning the drills on his shoulders, blocking the Nonochio mecha's attack route head-on.
Huang Xuejing, a little girl from the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World, raised her right wrist and inserted the star card into the summoner.
Fierce Wind emerges from the light beam in the shape of a car, then transforms into a robot form. The Sky Light Sword is in the hands of Meng Feng.
The white light wolf descended at the same time, the wolf head mask glowed with a cold metallic luster in the red light of the lava, and the star-moon scimitar and wolf shield were in his hands.
The little girl Yang Xinying, who is a member of China's low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World Power, raised her right wrist and inserted the star card into the summoner.
Seismosaurus descends from the beam of light in the form of a drill, burrows into the ground, emerges from the earth, and transforms into its robot form.
The little boy Tang Qiongkai of the Chinese Low-Level Technology Baiyuan Brave World Wisdom raised his right wrist and inserted the star card into the summoner.
The Light and Shadow Flying Tiger arrives in the form of a high-speed train and transforms into a robot form with a bow and arrow in hand. This is a fake fight.
Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World Brave Little Girl Huang Xuejing controls in the synchronous spaceFierce wind and white light wolf, the little girl Yang Xinying who is the power of China's low-level technology White Yuan Brave World controls the earthquake dragon in the synchronous space, and the little boy Tang Qiongkai who is the wisdom warrior of the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World controls the light and shadow flying tiger in the synchronous space.
Three White Elemental King Kongs and White Light Wolves fought with Nonochio's mecha. Sword lights, drills, and arrows intertwined, dragging Nonochio on the battlefield.
The battle was real, but the White Elemental Heroes didn't use their full strength. They could defeat Nonochio, but not now.
The purpose of the fake fight is to hold off Nonochio and buy time for Tian Nana, a little girl from China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors - Vitality Brave World Wisdom Brave - she must find the Ice Bear and gain the power of ice and snow in order to resolve this lava crisis.
Tian Nana, a little girl from China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's World of Vitality Brave World of Wisdom and Brave, and Hu Wei, a little boy from China's low-level technology White Yuan Brave World's Giant Panda Beast, have left the battlefield and are heading towards the snow-capped mountains where the Ice Bear is.
